_notes.rows: landed from the board by board-sync.js land; never typed by an agent
_notes.unknown: a question; the cell stays a question until a person answers
_notes.unknownByDecision: true only when a person decided the value can stay unknown for this job; gate-b-check.js accepts that and nothing else
_notes.na: true only when a person marked the whole register not applicable on the board; naBy and naAt record who and when
_notes.cost, loading: flow into budget.xlsx through the production planner, never typed twice
_notes.availability: flows into the affected day sheets only
_notes.picture: a file name under Client Assets or a link the person gave
